headlines.text: On this day in 2021, Lance Archer vs. Rey Fenix met in a Qualifying Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.62 ? a well-worked match.

Rewind to 2024, when Sammy Guevara reached a real landmark moment: their 100th match in AEW, facing Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Sammy Guevara in a No DQ match, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 7.87 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
It was 2023 when Sammy Guevara vs. Action Andretti closed out Rampage, rated 6.69.

secondaries.text: It was 2021 when Garrison & Pillman Jr. left that name behind for good, stepping out as The Varsity Blonds after 1 match under the old identity, on Dynamite.
Rewind to 2024, when Bryan Danielson vs. Jun Akiyama headlined Collision, rated 7.41 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
It was 2023 when The Young Bucks vs. Aussie Open crossed paths for the first time ever, opening the card on Rampage, rated 7.81 ? a solid showing.
